source_segments.text: Kevin Lewis (footballer, born 1970) Kevin Lewis (born 17 October 1970) is an English former footballer who played in the Football League for Stoke City.
His uncle of the same name, was also a footballer who played for Stoke City.
Lewis was born in Kingston upon Hull and played in the youth team of Stoke City.

With Stoke's 1987–88 campaign coming to a close with nothing to play for manager Mick Mills decided to give youth team players some first team experience and Lewis made his a substitute in a 2–0 defeat away at Millwall on 30 April 1988.
